title: Fixed Time Steps
summary: Physics that depends on the frame time behaves slightly differently at every frame rate. A fixed time step runs the simulation in equal steps whatever the frame rate - this lesson builds the accumulator loop, guards against the spiral of death, and interpolates between steps for smooth drawing.

cards.a: Real time that has passed but has not been simulated yet, less than one step after the loop.

cards.q: What is the spiral of death, and how do you avoid it?
cards.a: Steps that take longer than real time make each frame slower than the last; limit the steps per frame or clamp the frame time.
accumulator / step: how far the current time is between the last two simulation steps.
